# Digilent rgb2dvi

`rgb2dvi/` is copied unchanged from Digilent's vivado-library:
https://github.com/Digilent/vivado-library

Pinned upstream commit: `0362ce72d39eebc400fdabacff706ee7fa8ad564`.
Source directory: `ip/rgb2dvi`.

The source files carry the BSD 3-clause license and copyright notices. The
`ResetBridge` entity is included in the core's `src/SyncAsyncReset.vhd`.

# Digilent dvi2rgb
`dvi2rgb/` is copied from the same Digilent vivado-library commit (`ip/dvi2rgb`). Used by the live-video build (HDMI RX at 800x600,
the lowest mode the IP supports). BSD 3-clause, see source headers. Local changes: `src/dvi2rgb.vhd` has one added output port `dbg`
(eye sizes, alignment error, bitslip, valid, ready per channel; marked LOCAL ADDITION), and `src/dgl_800x600.data` is an added
800x600@60-only EDID generated by `scripts/gen_edid.py`.
